channel.title: ToolTide
channel.description: Free online tools: countdown timers, calculators, unit converters, text tools and generators.

item.title: Laundry Detergent Calculator — The Right Dose per Wash
item.description: How much detergent per wash? Load size, soil level and water hardness give the right liquid or powder dose - and why overdosing makes clothes worse. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Fish Tank Stocking Calculator — How Many Fish Your Tank Supports
item.description: How many fish for your tank? Litres and adult fish size with community, cichlid and goldfish stocking rules, plus the nitrogen-cycle reality. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: TV Size Calculator — Right Screen Size for Your Sofa Distance
item.description: What size TV for your room? Sofa distance and resolution give the right diagonal in inches, with screen width and the too-close limit. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: E-Bike Charging Cost Calculator — Cents per Charge and per 100 km
item.description: What an e-bike really costs to run: charge cost from battery Wh and your electricity price, per 100 km and per year, with charger losses counted. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Bike Saddle Height Calculator — by Inseam and Riding Type
item.description: Correct saddle height from your inseam: LeMond factor for road, comfort and MTB variants, plus the knee-pain diagnostics. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: E-Bike Range Calculator — Real km from Your Battery
item.description: Real e-bike range, not brochure range: battery Wh divided by honest Wh/km for your assist level, with cold-weather and battery-health reality. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Carpool Savings Calculator — What Sharing the Ride Saves You
item.description: What carpooling actually saves: shared driving cost per person per year, CO₂ taken off the road, and the schedule rules that keep a pool alive. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Mileage Reimbursement Calculator — Total Owed for Your Trips
item.description: Total mileage reimbursement: distance times rate, in miles or km, with the gap versus your true cost per km and fuel-only warning. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Commute Cost Calculator — Car vs Transit, the Honest Totals
item.description: What does your commute really cost? Car all-in per km versus transit pass, per year and per day, with the fuel-is-a-third truth. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Curtain Fabric Calculator — Metres by Track Width and Fullness
item.description: How much fabric for curtains? Track width, finished drop, fullness ratio and roll width give panels, cut length and total metres, with hem and repeat advice. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Knitting Cast-On Calculator — Stitches for Hats by Gauge
item.description: How many stitches to cast on for a hat: head circumference, your blocked gauge, negative ease and the pattern multiple handled in one number. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Yarn Yardage Calculator — Metres Needed from Your Swatch
item.description: How much yarn does your project need? Swatch area and yarn used scaled to project size, with skein count, 15% buffer and dye-lot advice. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Silver Value Calculator — Melt Value by Weight and Purity
item.description: What is my silver worth? Weight, purity (999/925/800) and current spot price give the melt value, per-gram figure and a realistic dealer offer range. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Subscription Cost Calculator — The Real Yearly Total
item.description: Add up what your subscriptions really cost per year: four lines with monthly, quarterly or yearly billing, biggest-cost callout and cut-one savings. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Flight Delay Compensation Calculator — EU261 Fixed Amounts
item.description: What your delayed flight is worth: EU261/UK261 fixed compensation by distance and arrival delay, plus care and receipt rules. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Data Usage Calculator — GB per Month from Your Real Hours
item.description: How much data do you actually use? Streaming quality, music, video calls and browsing hours turned into GB per day and month, matched against plan caps. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Creatine Calculator — Loading and Maintenance Dose by Weight
item.description: Creatine dose by bodyweight: loading week vs maintenance-only, grams per day, how long a 500 g tub lasts, and the no-cycling truth. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Protein Intake Calculator — Grams per Day by Weight and Goal
item.description: How much protein do you need? Grams per day by bodyweight and goal — cutting, building, active or 60+ — with real-food equivalents. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Formula Feeding Calculator — ml per Feed by Weight
item.description: How much formula per feed? Enter baby weight and feeds per day for ml per feed using the 150 ml/kg/day rule, with the safe 120-200 range. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Wake Window Calculator — Ranges by Baby Age in Months
item.description: Typical wake windows by age in months: how long a baby can stay up between naps, nap counts and total daily sleep, with cue-reading guidance. Free, no sign-up.
